input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
input.rationale: The Agreement renews automatically for successive 1-year terms (renewal length is compliant), but nothing lets Customer stop a renewal: the only exit is the mutual "for any reason" right on ninety (90) days' written notice after the Initial Term, which fails the fallback ceiling of a non-renewal notice window of no more than 60 days and sits at the walk-away boundary. We have therefore carved a Customer non-renewal election of sixty (60) days directly into the auto-renewal trigger in paragraph 4(a), so the renewal is stopped by that notice; every other word of 4(a), including Kubient's 90-day notice right, its fee entitlement and the paragraph 4(b) breach/insolvency mechanics, is preserved verbatim. The price-cap element is not engaged: renewal carries the same revenue-share economics with no unilateral price-increase or uplift mechanic (fees are set in each Exhibit). Sixty days is the fallback ceiling; we should not concede a longer window.

proposal.summary: Carve a Customer 60-day non-renewal notice into the auto-renewal trigger
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We carved a Customer non-renewal election into the auto-renewal trigger itself, so renewal is stopped by sixty (60) days' notice of non-renewal, consistent with our fallback position of a non-renewal window of no more than 60 days. Kubient's 90-day post-Initial-Term notice right is untouched.

ops.newText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless Customer gives sixty (60) days' notice of non-renewal or earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
